ca.name: Name

server.title: Server certificate

address.label: Address

connection.unencrypted: Connection to {{name}} unencrypted, the API key is sent in plain text.

readOnlyBanner.title: Status only
readOnlyBanner.description: In this version the servers are only queried. Actions such as wake, starting the VM or sync are not available yet.

certificate.renewalFailed: The automatic renewal of the TLS server certificate failed. Please check the container log.
certificate.serverExpires_one: The TLS server certificate expires in {{count}} day. Please check the container log.
certificate.serverExpires_other: The TLS server certificate expires in {{count}} days. Please check the container log.
certificate.caExpires_one: The TwinRaid CA expires in {{count}} day. Create a new one with twinraid-admin renew-cert --new-ca and install it on all devices.
certificate.caExpires_other: The TwinRaid CA expires in {{count}} days. Create a new one with twinraid-admin renew-cert --new-ca and install it on all devices.

caChange.title: New TwinRaid CA – install it again on all devices
caChange.when: The CA was created again on {{date}}. Reason: {{reason}}.
caChange.action: Download the new CA certificate in Settings, install it on every device and remove the old one. Until then browsers show a warning.
caChange.failed: The acknowledgement failed. Please try again.

reasons.legacy_replaced: the self-signed certificate of an older version was replaced
